Order 
1.
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of regular bail.

3. The applicant has been arrested on 29.01.2025 in connection with Crime No.716/2023 registered at Police Station Cantt., District Guna for offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 120-B, 471, 201 of IPC.

4. Prosecution story, in short, is that the present applicant along with other co-accused persons, on the pretext of allotment of government land obtained about Rs.11 Lac and photocopies of aadhar cards from 21 victim persons and commit fraud.
The applicant along with other co-accused persons is accused of defrauding the complainant along with other similar innocent persons.
The complainant lodged a complaint at P.S. Cantt. Guna.
During investigation, statements of complainant and other witnesses were NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10297 2 MCRC-20617-2025 recorded and the fake documents were seized.
Accordingly, offence has been registered against the present applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Applicant is in custody since 29.01.2025.
Only omnibus allegations have been levelled against him without any substantial documentary evidence.
Nothing has been recovered from the possession of the applicant.

Co-accused persons namely, Brijnath Kushwah and Sachin Kumar Dandi have already been enlarged on by bail by this Court order dated 04.04.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No.14082/2025 and order dated 22.04.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No.17427/2025,
respectively.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
Applicant is permanent resident of District Guna and there is no likelihood of his absconsion.
Final conclusion of trial will take a considerable long time.
Hence, he prays that applicant may be released on bail.

6 . Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection but he fairly submitted that applicant is not having any criminal history.
7.
Both the parties heard and perused the case diary.

8. Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, also taking note of the facts that only omnibus allegation has been levelled against present applicant and it appears that no document has been recovered from the possession of the applicant,
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10297 3 MCRC-20617-2025 investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed; two co-accused persons have already been enlarged on bail and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
9.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C/480(3) of BNSS.
C.C. as per rules.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE Vishal Mahesh Prajapati vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86081961/
